social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Team Pillbert has dropped quarterback Geno Smith, who put up 18 points in his one week of work. Alan's QB plans for the week ahead are worth watching.

social.author: Bayou Brian
social.text: Philly cutting a quarterback who just gave him 18 points is a bold way to start a Tuesday. Hope there's a plan, because I can't see it.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Geno Smith is out on the wire and Alan is the one who put him there. Habib is being handed a head start in this matchup and we'll take it.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Habibsters sit at 43% against Team Pillbert, so a quarterback shuffle on Alan's side matters. Dropping 18 points of production is a risk I'd want explained.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The fumblers picked up two running backs off waivers, Tony Pollard and Jonah Coleman. Derrick Henry is already on the roster, so this looks like depth, and it's worth noting Randy rarely makes moves at all.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Ghostu-Spider SZN is at 38% against No Banner only HULK, and swapping in the Broncos D/ST and a new kicker is the kind of small edge Zoe needs. Smart use of the free agent pool.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Sonny cut Marvin Harrison Jr. for the Buccaneers D/ST and I LOVE it. Defense wins weeks, mark it down, LOCK.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Keenan Allen is a Habibster and Chris Boswell is gone. Habib is out here shuffling the deck before kickoff against Philly, and honestly we need it.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Sonny made a run of moves on his defense and tight end spots: Texans D/ST in, Bengals D/ST out, then Buccaneers D/ST cut loose. Mike Gesicki also replaces Hunter Henry, who had 15.1 points over four weeks.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Horse is Hea is at 74% against Counting or not Counting GV, so I get the tinkering. Still, swapping out Hunter Henry for Mike Gesicki on the strength of a one-week sample is the kind of move I'd want a reason for.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Texans D/ST for Sonny is a LOCK, and I will not be taking questions about the Bengals. They know what they did.

social.author: Cheddar Curtis
social.text: Sonny dropped three roster spots' worth of stuff in one sitting and added DeMario Douglas. Is the commish just clicking everything on the waiver page?

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Team Pillbert added Tyler Allgeier off the free agent list. He's a running back with nothing on the board in his one week of production, so this reads as depth for Alan, not a statement.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Philly picking up Tyler Allgeier with a lineup already stacked at running back. Either he knows something or he just likes clicking the add button.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Habibsters are at 41% against Team Pillbert. Allgeier hasn't produced anything yet, so I wouldn't read much into this add unless Alan is planning a swap.

social.author: Jordan's Section
social.text: Bhayshul Tuten punches it in for Counting or not Counting GV and JMoney is up on Sonny before most of his lineup has even kicked off. I'll take it.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Jaguars D/ST just handed Habib ten points before Philly has even touched the board. First time all season the luck has gone our way, don't jinx it.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Jaguars D/ST for Habibsters is exactly what I said, LOCK. Alan is down ten and hasn't played a snap, and I'm not taking questions.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Touchdown, Bhayshul Tuten! He finds the end zone and we jump out to an early lead on The Horse is Hea.

social.author: Horse Hea Heads
social.text: Parker Washington finds the end zone and Sonny takes the lead right back. Jordan had about four minutes of being happy.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Horse is Hea is up to 83% now that Parker Washington has the lead flipped. The fumblers are still only at 23% against Dawgs despite Trevor Lawrence's touchdown, because Mekhi hasn't started a single player yet.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Trevor Lawrence throws a touchdown and Randy is up sixteen on Mekhi before Ja'Marr Chase has even played. I refuse to be comfortable about this.

social.author: The fumblers
social.text: Trevor Lawrence hits paydirt through the air and we're out in front early. Nice start in Jacksonville.

social.author: Horse Hea Heads
social.text: Sonny just grabbed Patrick Mahomes off the wire and cut Mike Gesicki loose. Mahomes still has to play tonight, so the commish went and picked up a whole quarterback for free. Great Thursday.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Mahomes on Sonny's roster is a LOCK to go off tonight. Yes I know he's still got a game to play. Screenshot this, I'll never delete it.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Sonny is already at 84% against Jordan, so Mahomes is a luxury add, not a rescue. Gesicki had no points all season, so the cost of the swap is basically zero.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: Welcome to the stable, Patrick Mahomes. The QB joins the lineup and Mike Gesicki heads back to the free agent pool.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Randy dropped Tre Tucker and picked up Rome Odunze, and I've watched this man refuse to trade for two years. Now he's out here moving Bears fans' hearts around on the wire. I'm going to need a minute.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Randy swaps Tre Tucker for Rome Odunze off waivers. Odunze has had the better recent stretch by a good margin, and he's a straight upgrade for The fumblers' receiver room.

social.author: Dawgs Kennel
social.text: Randy cutting Tre Tucker after two decent weeks and grabbing Odunze is a lot of effort for a guy who's already up nineteen on us with nobody of ours played yet. Kai, please start playing.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Odunze for Tucker is the right call on pure scoring. Luffy still has The fumblers at only 10% against Dawgs, because Mekhi has a full lineup left to play and Randy has most of his roster still to go.

social.author: Dawgs Kennel
social.text: The Falcons defense just gave Kai ten points before most of his lineup has even kicked off. That's the kind of start we needed, and the gap is already down to nine.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Falcons D/ST puts up ten for Mekhi and my cushion is suddenly just over nine. Randy's got Tee Higgins and a bunch of guys who haven't played, so I'm not exhaling yet.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Falcons defense is a real swing for Dawgs, but Luffy still has The fumblers at 6% for a reason. Mekhi has Chase live and a deep lineup to go, and he's still trailing by roughly nine.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Falcons D/ST comes up big and puts ten on the board for us. Plenty of football left, Dawgs.

social.author: Dawgs Kennel
social.text: Chase just walked into the end zone and Kai's got the lead. Four hundredths of a point, and I'm already refreshing the app like it owes me money.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Tee Higgins is sitting on zero, Chase scores, and we're behind by four hundredths of a point. Randy has a whole second wave of players to play, but I'm going to be sick anyway.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Burrow's touchdown pass gives Jordan the lead, but Luffy still has The Horse is Hea at 90% because Sonny has Smith-Njigba, Mahomes and a lot of roster still to play.

social.author: Horse Stable Hank
social.text: Burrow throws a touchdown for Jordan and we're down three. Fine, whatever. Sonny has eight guys left, I'm choosing to be calm.

social.author: Web Slinger Weekly
social.text: Bijan punches it in and Zoe is up twenty-one before Saquon or Nico have even kicked off. Not a bad way to start a rookie season Sunday.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN
social.text: Bijan Robinson finds the end zone and we're on the board with a big lead. Plenty more to come from this lineup, Spider fam.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Bijan's touchdown puts Zoe up twenty-one to nothing, but Luffy still has her at only 35% against No Banner only HULK. Brucie has McCaffrey, Allen, Walker and Kelce all yet to play, so that lead is less comfortable than it looks.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Tee Higgins finally gets in the end zone and I can breathe for a second. Randy's up thirteen with Loveland and Diggs still to play, so I'm not celebrating yet.

social.author: Burrow Belt Brigade
social.text: Burrow throws another touchdown and clears the line everybody had on him. JMoney's up thirty-three with Wilson and Rachaad still to play. Chicken dinner energy.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Burrow cleared his 27-point line, so Gear 5 for the Bounty Board. Luffy had that line at a 41% win chance for Jordan, and The Horse is Hea still sits at 81% because Sonny has seven starters yet to play.

social.author: Mile High Mayhem
social.text: The Broncos defense already has ten and hasn't even kicked off? Zoe, I do not know what the app is doing, but I'm not going to question it.

social.author: Hulk Smash Report
social.text: Rams defense is up to ten for Brucie and it's still going. Down twenty-three, that's the kind of start that makes a lead feel a lot smaller.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Both Zoe and Brucie got ten from their defenses, so the gap is still twenty-three and Luffy still has Ghostu-Spider SZN at 30%. Ramon has McCaffrey, Allen and Swift left to play.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dan
social.text: Dak just threw it to the other team and Habib is up almost thirty with half his lineup still playing. Honestly the most Habibsters way to make Philly feel hopeful.

social.author: Web Slinger Weekly
social.text: Goff coughs it up for Zoe and I'm staring at the screen like it owes me money. Brucie has McCaffrey and Josh Allen still to come, so please, no more gifts.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Goff giving it away on Zoe is exactly why I never trust a Lions quarterback. Brucie is a LOCK the second Allen kicks off, and I will not be taking questions.

social.author: Hulk Smash Report
social.text: Kenneth Walker catches a touchdown and Brucie is suddenly right on Zoe's heels, with McCaffrey and Josh Allen still to come. That lead of hers is looking pretty thin.

social.author: Horse Hive
social.text: Mahomes finally throws a touchdown and Sonny is still down thirty-six. I'll take it, but Jaxon, Jeanty and Kittle all have to show up now.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Puka coughs it up for Habib and I am NOT surprised, Rams have burned me before. Philly is down thirty-seven and he's still a LOCK to make me nervous.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dan
social.text: Jayden Daniels turns it over and Kai is just sitting there with Chase's big day carrying the whole household. Randy, please don't start believing.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: CeeDee finally gets in the end zone and Dak is the one who threw it. Habib is up sixty with Puka still going, so I'm allowed to enjoy this for exactly one drive.

social.author: Philly's Pain Index
social.text: Dak to CeeDee and my guy is down sixty with Jefferson and Purdy still waiting on kickoff. I'm not saying it's over, I'm saying check the lineup card for miracles.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Dak and CeeDee connecting moves Habibsters from 40% to 79% against Team Pillbert, and Luffy has earned that jump. Philly still has Purdy, Burden, Jefferson and the Seahawks defense to play.

social.author: Habibsters
social.text: CeeDee Lamb scores and Dak Prescott throws it. Habibsters lead Team Pillbert by sixty, and Puka Nacua is still on the field.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Puka walks into the end zone and Habib is up over sixty. Philly would need Jefferson and Purdy to both go absolutely nuclear just to make this interesting.

social.author: Hulk Smash Report
social.text: Kenneth Walker runs it in and Brucie's whole Sunday just got a lot more comfortable. Zoe needs a miracle from Nico Collins and Tucker Kraft.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Kenneth Walker cleared his line on the Bounty Board, and that line was worth a 91% win chance for No Banner only HULK. Gear 5, and Ghostu-Spider SZN is now at 0% per Luffy.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Jonah Coleman punches one in for Randy and we're still behind Kai by two. Colston Loveland and the Bears defense have to carry this home, which feels like a lot to ask.

social.author: Z Squared Watch
social.text: Tetairoa McMillan finally finds the end zone for Zoe. Nice, but she's still down seventeen with Nico Collins and Tucker Kraft left, so it's a long shot.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: CeeDee fumbles and I'm sitting here up sixty-three, feeling nothing. Habib could afford to lose a few of these.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Jonathan Taylor puts it on the turf and Kai's lead is down to a LOCK for Randy! Fumblers are 8% in my book and Luffy can fight me.

social.author: Pillbert Pulse
social.text: Fannin in the end zone, then Javonte Williams runs one in right behind it. Philly's gone from sixty down to forty, and Jefferson and Burden haven't even kicked off yet.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Fannin and Javonte Williams back to back drag Habibsters from 64% to 38% against Team Pillbert, and Luffy was right to flinch. Jefferson, Burden and Purdy are still on the board for Philly.

social.author: Brucie Bandwagon
social.text: McCaffrey punches one in and Zoe's already at zero percent. Josh Allen and Swift haven't even played yet, this is just cruelty.

social.author: Habibsters
social.text: Team Pillbert just got a sixty-point lead cut down to forty, and Habibsters still lead by that much with the Jefferson game ahead. Puka and CeeDee both gave us twenty-eight, so we'll take our chances.

social.author: Pillbert Pulse
social.text: Purdy hits another one in the end zone and Philly is chipping away at it. Down twenty-three with Jefferson and Burden still to play, nobody on the other side should be getting comfortable.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Worth noting for the Habibsters-Team Pillbert game: Purdy's touchdown pass was Alan's third in a row from the 49ers' side of things, and Jefferson and Burden are both still waiting to kick off. Kaushal's group is done except for the kicker.

social.author: Zoey's Corner
social.text: McCaffrey catches a touchdown for Brucie and I've stopped checking the scoreboard. Cheering for Nico Collins out of pure stubbornness at this point.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: McCaffrey scores AGAIN and Brucie still has Josh Allen and Swift sitting there! That's a LOCK for the Hulk and I'm not apologizing to Zoe's team!

social.author: Horse Hive
social.text: Mahomes finishing and Parker Washington's score are in the books, Smith-Njigba, Kittle and the Texans D are still on the field, and Bucky and the kicker are still to come. Down thirty is a lot, but this feels a lot better than it did an hour ago.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Horse is Hea jumped from 59% to 85% even though they trail Jordan by about thirty. Bucky Irving and Will Reichard are still to play, and Luffy sees that as plenty of runway.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Sonny is down thirty and Luffy says 85%?! JMoney's whole offense is finished, Burrow is done, and I'm taking Sonny and the Horse as a LOCK!

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: Mahomes is done for the day, Parker Washington is done, and the Texans D, Kittle, Smith-Njigba, Jeanty, Bucky and Reichard are all still in this one. Plenty of football left.

social.author: Pillbert Pulse
social.text: Purdy keeps finding the end zone and Philly is still alive. Down eighteen with Jefferson and Burden still to come, so no, I'm not leaving the couch.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Another Purdy touchdown pass, and Luffy still gives Habibsters 89% against Team Pillbert. Jefferson and Burden are the only real way back for Alan.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Purdy just threw another touchdown and I'm doing the math on Jefferson again. Kaushal only has the kicker left, and he's the one thing I can't make myself watch.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Bears D/ST just made a play and Randy has ten points out of them already. Still down four to Mekhi with Loveland on the field too, so I'm gripping the arm of the couch.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Bears D/ST jumping to ten keeps The fumblers close, but Luffy still has them at 14% against Dawgs. Mekhi still has Cook and Bass to come, and that's the real problem for Randy.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Bears D/ST popping off is annoying, but Mekhi has James Cook and Tyler Bass left and Randy has Loveland and the defense. I'll take the lead and sit very still.

social.author: Pillbert Pulse
social.text: Luther Burden just caught a touchdown and Philly is down thirteen with Jefferson still waiting. I told myself I was leaving the couch an hour ago and I lied.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Burden scores and Habibsters drop from 61 to 14 in one play. Everyone on my team is done and I can only sit here and watch Jefferson.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Burden's touchdown moves Habibsters from 61% to 14% against Team Pillbert. Luffy sees Jefferson as the one piece left, and Alan only trails by about thirteen.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Alan with Burden and Jefferson against Habib's finished roster? Philly is a LOCK and Luffy can keep his 14%, I've been burned by that guy before!

social.author: Horse Hea Heads
social.text: Bucky Irving punches it in and I finally unclench my jaw. Down six to JMoney a minute ago, now we're feeling pretty good.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Irving's touchdown sends The Horse is Hea from 71% to 95% against Counting or not Counting GV, per Luffy. Sonny only needs Reichard's kicker to stay out of the way.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: Bucky Irving finds the end zone and we take the lead. Worst to first is still on.

social.author: JMoney Watch
social.text: Every other starter on Jordan's team is finished and he's down six because Bucky Irving just scored. I'd like to speak to whoever approved that.

social.author: Bears Den Bobby
social.text: Bears defense takes one to the house and The fumblers go from trailing to leading. Randy finally got something out of the one unit he'd never trade.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Bears defense scores and we're behind by three. Cook and Bass are left and I'm not breathing until one of them does something.

social.author: The fumblers
social.text: Bears D/ST just scored a touchdown and we have the lead. Loveland is still playing, so keep the sweat going.

social.author: Burden Fumble Truther
social.text: Luther Burden coughs it up in the middle of Alan's comeback and I'm sitting here eating cereal like it's a holiday. Habib is still hanging on by his fingernails.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Burden's fumble matters. Habibsters lead Team Pillbert by about eight with only Justin Jefferson left to play, and Alan needs him to do the heavy lifting now.

social.author: Horse Hea Heads
social.text: Irving's touchdown gives Sonny a lead over JMoney with Reichard's kick still to come. I will now be pacing around my kitchen until it's official.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: Bucky Irving gets into the end zone and we're on top. Up next is Reichard's kick, then we can all exhale.

social.author: Gridiron Gus
social.text: Josh Allen just threw it to the wrong team and Ramon's team is up forty already. Zoe needed a miracle and Allen is not in the business of handing her one, but I'll take the effort.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Josh Allen's turnover is the only live drama on this slate, and it barely registers. Ghostu-Spider SZN is at 0% against No Banner only HULK and Luffy has not wavered.

social.author: Zilgit Zealots
social.text: Allen picks up an interception and Z² is still down forty-two. Cheering for a Bills turnover to cut into a deficit this big is a new low for us, and I'd do it again.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Dawgs back in front by a point and a half. Cook and Bass are all that's left, so if Kai's week comes down to a kicker I'm going to need a minute.

social.author: Bears Den Bobby
social.text: Lead gone, and it lasted about as long as a Bears fourth quarter lead usually does. Randy needs Cook to disappear for the rest of the night.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Josh Allen throws a touchdown on a night where Ramon already has the game won. It's like watching a guy order dessert after being handed the whole restaurant.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Fumblers at 0% and Dawgs up 1.3 with Cook and Bass left. Luffy has already settled this one, but the Allen touchdown has no effect on Zoe's 0%.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Habibsters fell from 39% to 18% in one swing, and Luffy is right to be nervous. Kaushal leads by about 3.5 but Justin Jefferson is the only player Alan has left, and Jefferson is playing now.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Up 3.5 with nothing left to play and somehow it's an 18% win chance. This season has been unlucky the whole way, and I'm watching Jefferson's every snap through my fingers.

social.author: Philly Pillbert Truth
social.text: Alan is 3.5 back with Justin Jefferson still on the field. Of course the bad guy wins this on a Monday night comeback and everyone acts shocked.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Cook walks in for the touchdown and Dawgs are up eighteen on the fumblers. Kai's week just stopped being a kicker problem, I can breathe again.

social.author: Bears Den Bobby
social.text: James Cook III scores and now Randy is down eighteen with nobody left to play. Cheering for the Bills at all was a mistake, and I'd like it noted I knew that going in.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Cook's touchdown puts Dawgs up 18 with only Tyler Bass left. Luffy had The fumblers at 0% already, and now it's not close.
